_description: Supply-chain facts that are true today and are owed a fix. Every entry carries a reason; an undeclared finding fails the guard and an entry that no longer matches fails it too, so the list only shrinks.

moving-tags.reason: Live defect recorded on 2026-09-20: the deployed signaling server compose file pulls the :latest tag, so a rollback redeploys whatever was pushed most recently rather than the build that was tested. Owned by services/signaling-server, not by the lane that added this guard.

The local development database console, referenced with no tag at all so it resolves to :latest. It never runs in a deployment and holds no product data, but an untagged image still makes two developers disagree about what they are running.

unpinned-tags.reason: Local development Postgres, pinned to the pg16 line rather than a digest so a patch release is picked up without a manifest edit. It is not part of any deployed image and the production database is Neon, not this container.

The signaling server builds from the node:24-alpine tag in four stages so security patches on the Node 24 line arrive without a manifest edit. Digest pinning here needs a renovation job to move the digest, which does not exist yet.
